name: tabia-cli
description: Reaching a deployed Tabia environment from the command line with the `tabia` CLI: profiles and personal access tokens, reading through `tabia ls` and `tabia api`, and moving care pathways, flows, surveys and funnels between environments or organizations with export/plan/resolve/import — or writing a solution as a package file in the first place. Encodes the guardrails that matter — personal data stays out of the transcript, and nothing is written to production without a human at the prompt.
suggestedPrompts: List the diabetes pathways in staging for acme
Export flow 42 from staging into a solution package
Validate our new solution package against production
